clusters: conversation-minute: (source address, destination address, destination port, protocol, 60 s window of FLOW_START_MILLISECONDS); a cluster never crosses roles
duplicates: exact model-feature duplicates collapse to one row with a multiplicity count; groups whose rows disagree on Label are quarantined
label_policy: binary Label column; rows whose Label contradicts the Attack column are quarantined
missing: rows with a missing or non-finite model feature are dropped and counted per class
reference_population: distinct flow records after duplicate collapse; multiplicity kept
role_assignment: clusters shuffled within each attack family (or Benign) and allocated by cumulative row share
source: NetFlow v3 datasets, University of Queensland (Luay et al. 2025, arXiv 2503.04404)
